narration_lines: This is our street. We know where to walk: along the pavement, beside the curb.
Now water covers the street. It looks different.
Can you still see the curb? Can you see the drain? Can you see the hole? They are still there. The water is hiding them.
The water did not make the street smooth. It only hid the street.
Floodwater can push things. Water that looks calm can still be moving.
Floodwater connects the road, drain, garden, rubbish area and canal. It can bring things from somewhere else.
Some dangers are hidden. Some are too small to see.
Same place. Different rules. When water covers places that are normally dry, stay with a grown-up and stay out of the floodwater.
